column1: 7-day booking gets no 10% weekly discount; total $840.00 instead of $756.00
column4:

The 10% weekly discount should apply from exactly 7 days. The 6-day case behaved as expected (discount $0.00, total $720.00). The 8-day case was not reached because the test stopped at the 7-day failure.

h3. Preconditions
* Tesla Model 3 ($120.00/day) is available for 7 consecutive days in the future
* Logged in as agent
* Customer Mei Tanaka exists

h3. Steps to reproduce
# Open http://localhost:8102/bookings/new
# Select Car: Tesla Model 3 — $120.00/day
# Select Customer: Mei Tanaka
# Enter pickup_date 2026-10-21 and return_date 2026-10-28 (7 days)
# Click Confirm booking
# Observe the booking page (e.g. /bookings/27): subtotal, weekly discount and total

h3. Expected
7 days: subtotal 840.00, discount 84.00 (10%), total 756.00.

h3. Actual
Days 7, Subtotal $840.00, Weekly discount −$0.00, Total $840.00. The confirmation message says 'Estimated total $840.00'.

h3. Environment
Chrome 154.0.8037.93 · Darwin 25.5.0 · 1440×900 (desktop) · role: agent
URL: http://localhost:8102/bookings/27
Reproducibility: 3/3 · severity: major (Pricing is wrong: customers are charged $84.00 too much on every 7-day booking, and there is no workaround on the booking screen. The error is a fixed 10% overcharge at the threshold boundary.)

column1: Booking accepted when pickup date equals existing booking's return date
column4:
Creating a booking for Hyundai Tucson starting 2026-10-17 was confirmed even though an existing booking for the same car ends on 2026-10-17. The inclusive overlap check on boundary dates is not enforced. Reproduced in 1 of 3 runs.

h3. Preconditions
* Logged in as agent
* Hyundai Tucson has a reserved booking from 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-17 (customer Mei Tanaka)

h3. Steps to reproduce
# Open http://localhost:8102/bookings/new
# Select Car "Hyundai Tucson — $70.00/day"
# Select Customer "Mei Tanaka"
# Enter pickup_date 2026-10-15 and return_date 2026-10-17
# Click "Confirm booking" (booking B-0012 is created)
# Open /bookings/new again
# Select Car "Hyundai Tucson — $70.00/day" and Customer "Mei Tanaka"
# Enter pickup_date 2026-10-17 and return_date 2026-10-19
# Click "Confirm booking"

h3. Expected
The second booking is refused as overlapping, because pickup 2026-10-17 falls on the existing booking's return date 2026-10-17 (inclusive overlap check).

h3. Actual
The booking was accepted. The app redirected to http://localhost:8102/bookings/13 with the message "Booking confirmed. Estimated total $140.00." Booking B-0013 (Tucson, 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-19) now overlaps the existing 10-15 to 10-17 reservation. Reproducibility 1/3.

h3. Environment
Chrome 154.0.8037.93 · Darwin 25.5.0 · 1440×900 (desktop) · role: agent
URL: http://localhost:8102/bookings/13
Reproducibility: 1/3 · severity: major (Double-booking the same car on a shared boundary date breaks a core booking rule and can leave the car committed to two customers, with no visible workaround for the agent. Reproduces only intermittently (1/3).)
Test cases: TC-BOO-019
Evidence (in the QA Pilot run folder): artifacts/bugs/BUG-007/annotated.png, artifacts/bugs/BUG-007/clip.mp4
